lidar: USGS CO_DRCOG_2_2020 (https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/usgs-lidar-public/CO_DRCOG_2_2020/ept.json), classes 2 (ground) and 17 (bridge deck), through tools/lidar_connector_profile.py's tile cache and reader
_doc: Item 3 (ledger 0098 'the lap's height on the Quebec St bridge over Sand Creek'): along the lap every 1 m (s_lap) from APPROACH_M before the class-17 deck's first reading on the lap's centre line to APPROACH_M past its last, at the centre line and both wheel paths (u = -+ drive_test.WHEEL_HALF_TRACK). Each path: the median of the class-17 returns within 1.0 m (3 or more; lidar_connector_profile's rule) and a plane through them (6 or more), the class-2 median likewise; real_y = the deck where read, else the ground; built_y = centerline.local.json y (the centre line's, used for all three paths); built_minus_real_m. pad_sandcreek_quebec_rows: data/pads.built.json's rows of the pad (row 1 = its S row on the deck), each point's deck / ground under it and built minus real.
